The public is invited to join a livestreamed celebration on Friday marking the moment a distant spacecraft reaches a distance of one light-day from Earth. The event will begin at 10 a.m. Eastern time and will feature remarks from mission scientists and engineers, who will describe what the spacecraft has learned over nearly five decades of travel. A special segment will explain how the team continues to communicate with the probe, which transmits at roughly the power of a refrigerator light bulb. Viewers will be able to submit questions in advance through the agency's social media channels. The broadcast will be available on the agency's website and streaming platforms, with captions in English and Spanish. Media representatives wishing to attend in person at the control center should contact the public affairs office by Wednesday.
